subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: honesty is a noble virtue it is the secret of success in every sphere of life the value of honesty is very great it brings love respect and fearlessness an honest man passes his days in mental peace in respect of happiness honesty is the best policy Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: Honesty is a noble virtue; it is the secret of success in every sphere of life. The value of honesty is very great. It brings love, respect and fearlessness. An honest man passes his days in mental peace. In respect of happiness, honesty is the best policy. ● Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
